limitations: Actual Linux AMD64 server image plus PostgreSQL/pgvector and Redis; installing the unrelated operator honcho-ai SDK is not this server software gate.
The released v3.1.1 image identifies source commit 5d992bc65afcfbc05a5911ab4edbaa88ef64c690, not the newer source-review HONCHO_COMMIT in config/versions.lock.
The same server image supplies the API and deriver; both processes, migrations, health checks, persistent storage and backups require a later explicit runtime deployment.
Upstream Compose uses trust database authentication and example passwords; it must not be started verbatim. Configure API authentication and prevent unauthenticated cross-Zone access.
LLM and embedding routes, provider credentials, budget and data-handling scope are external configuration choices, not inferred from another Hermes profile.
Pinned Hermes excludes the Honcho SDK from its all extra and pins a different SDK version; install and compatibility-test the native provider dependency in the actual Hermes runtime.
Hermes permits only one external memory provider per profile. Explicitly select Honcho, endpoint, workspace and peers; workspace names alone are not tenant authorization.
Native configuration can fall back from HERMES_HOME to Zone HOME configuration. Do not auto-adopt or copy existing accounts; keep multi-user peer identities distinct.
Readiness requires authenticated synthetic write, deriver completion, recall after restart and negative cross-Zone tests. No optional MCP server or monitoring demo is needed for Hermes native memory.
